title: Standards: rate-limit headers and quota semantics
goal: RateLimit-* drafts, vendor-specific x-ratelimit headers and Retry-After variants as one normalised model. Author the machine-readable profile (endpoints, auth, versions, request/response shapes, errors, rate-limit signals, streaming, capability tags) in config/ecosystem/ and test it offline against recorded fixtures. Facts come from official machine-readable specs or cited primary sources (no scraping that violates terms); every fact carries source, spec version, retrieved date and confidence.
